report.headline: CANTOS met its primary MACE endpoint in 10,061 post-MI patients with hsCRP ≥2 mg/L after 3.8 years median follow-up, demonstrating benefit from IL-1β inhibition not explained by lipid/BP changes (partial HR 0.991), though target genetics remain uncertain (IL1B score 0.05) and hsCRP is non-causal.
report.summary: The CANTOS trial randomized 10,061 patients with prior myocardial infarction and hsCRP ≥2 mg/L to canakinumab 150 mg monthly or placebo, with a median follow-up of 3.8 years. The trial met its primary endpoint of time to first major adverse cardiovascular event (CV death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke). Potent suppression of inflammatory biomarkers was observed: hsCRP reduced 43% and IL-6 reduced 42% (placebo-adjusted), alongside modest Lp(a) reduction (-4.3 mg/dL) and reduced vascular inflammation on MRI (-3.37 mm²). The calculator's lipid/BP model predicts a neutral partial HR of 0.991, confirming the benefit operates through an unquantified inflammatory pathway. Target genetics for IL1B are uncertain (score 0.05), and the intended biomarker hsCRP is classified as non-causal, though downstream IL-6 signalling is causal. Triglycerides increased 20% (placebo-adjusted), a potential off-target signal. Confidence is medium given the readout success but mechanistic uncertainty.

mechanism.notes: Biomarker changes are from phase 2b (PMC5064025) at the CANTOS dose (150 mg monthly SC) because phase 3 biomarker data were not yet public at the 2017-06-22 cut-off. IL-6 measured at 3 months vs 12 months for hsCRP, Lp(a), triglycerides - this mismatch may not reflect steady-state pathway modulation. issues.issue: Calculator inputs missing observed_hr and observed_ci for autopsy mode. CANTOS publication (NEJM 2017) reported HR 0.85 (95% CI 0.74-0.98) for 150 mg dose vs placebo. issues.issue: Verified facts lack CANTOS phase 3 safety data (fatal infections, sepsis). Only phase 2 safety (f_aba146d92f4b8c) is present. issues.issue: IL-6 biomarker change measured at 3 months while hsCRP, Lp(a), triglycerides at 12 months. Different timepoints may not reflect steady-state pathway modulation. The calculator uses these as simultaneous inputs for mechanism sizing.
